items.title: Coherence of the pushforward of the structure sheaf under a dimension condition on the associated primes of the complete local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement proves the coherence of the pushforward of the structure sheaf from the complement of a closed subset in an integral locally Noetherian scheme, under the assumption that every associated prime of the completion at a point of the complement has quotient of dimension at least two (author lemma at source lines 1835-1843, label lemma-sharp-finiteness-pushforward). The proof (source lines 1845-1896) reduces to a Noetherian local domain with the closed point in the complement and argues by induction on the dimension: passing to the punctured spectrum uses the induction hypothesis and an extension by a power of an element vanishing on the complement to reduce to the case where the complement is the closed point (proof lines 1854-1873), and the general case is then transferred from the completion, which is universally catenary and Nagata, using flat base change and faithful flat descent (proof lines 1876-1895). The induction together with the reduction to the completion is the content. H3.
